name: summoning-seal-materialise
intent: Seal rings draw via stroke, ticks snap in, then a tool panel expands from the seal center with clip/scale — not fade.

reducedMotion.behaviour: Seal fully drawn and panel already expanded

Exactly 8 ticks snap-scale in with the inner ring; reduced motion shows MATERIALISED immediately
